text:
Ava: Quick sync — I'm proposing a new "Microtiers" pricing shape: Starter / Dev-Pro / Team / Enterprise-Pro + feature-gated add-ons (priority-routing, long-context, dedicated KV). Need: launch criteria, contract constraints, and what to expose in Console first.

Sam K.: +1 on microtiers. Sales wants clear guardrails for enterprise add-ons. Customers asked for predictable burst behavior.

Maria P.: Need to model unit economics. Can we keep dev-pro under $$/token target? Also: any add-on that affects SLA needs separate pricing line.

Devon: Technical constraints: priority-routing implies separate routing queues and token accounting. We'll need rollout canary and per-customer priority weights.

Oliver R.: Legal note — if add-ons change data residency or dedicated KV, we must surface it in contract appendix. Also, minimum contract term for Dedicated add-ons? recommend 12mo.

Ava: Proposed launch checklist (short):
1) Pricing table for Console + SDK labels
2) Billing metering + quota enforcement implemented
3) Canary on 5 customers for priority-routing
4) Contract appendix draft for Dedicated add-ons
5) Docs + marketing one-pager

Sam K.: Sales asks: a soft burst credit for Starter (one-time onboarding credits) and a paid Burst Pack for Team/Enterprise. Keep soft credit automatic on signup.

Maria P.: Economics: model: Starter = free tier w/ monthly 100k tokens; Dev-Pro = $99/mo incl 5M tokens; Team = $999/mo incl 60M tokens; Enterprise-Pro = custom commit. Add-ons are per-M-token or fixed monthly for features. Example: priority-routing = $0.50 per 1M tokens or $200/mo min.

Devon: Implementation note: quota enforcement for Starter vs Dev-Pro must be in the API gateway so we can short-circuit before hitting runtime. We can reuse existing rate-limiter but need per-tenant buckets and billing tags.

Ava: Launch gating questions: what are the exact SLOs for priority-routing? and rollout metric for canary (error rate, p99 latency delta, cost delta)?

Devon: SLO suggestion: p99 latency <= baseline + 20ms; error-rate < 0.1% absolute increase; cost delta tracked per-token. Canary passes if no more than 1 of 5 customers exceed thresholds over 24h.

Oliver R.: Contract constraints: add a clause that feature availability may depend on infra region and capacity; define termination/rollback terms for feature-gated failures. Also add minimum notice for price changes: 60 days for Enterprise customers.

Maria P.: We should require metered reporting by product to finance (daily) and a reconciliation job monthly. Also telemetry tag `pricing_tier` + `add_on_flags`.

Sam K.: Sales ops note: Need SKU codes in the billing system before GA. Also a simple API label (e.g., `tier=dev-pro` + `addons=priority,long-ctx`).

Ava: UX ask: Console should show "effective monthly cost" estimate and next-billing projection. Also controls to toggle add-ons for dev accounts.

Pricing Bot: Pricing draft saved at /pricing/microtiers/draft-v1 — reviewers: @Ava @Maria P.

Ava: Next steps: Maria to provide finalized unit economics model by EOD Wed; Devon to prototype quota gates + canary config by next Tue; Oliver to draft contract appendix; Sam to align key pilot customers. Anyone object? :eyes:

Sam K.: No objections, I'll line up 3 pilot customers.

Maria P.: On it — will share model and sensitivity to burst assumptions.

Devon: Starting prototype tomorrow. I'll ping once there's a test tenant.

Oliver R.: I'll share contract language by Friday.

Ava: Great. We'll sync Monday AM for readiness. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
